annotations.title: Conforming and FHA loan limits for a county

description: The 2026 conforming loan limit for a U.S. county (1 to 4 units) from the Federal Housing Finance Agency's county file, whether the county is above the national baseline (high-balance), the county's FHA loan limits (1 to 4 units) from HUD's county file with its year, and the DealMatcher page to cite. Give a 5-digit county FIPS code, or a county name with its two-letter state.

county.description: county name, e.g. "Bexar" or "Los Angeles County"; give state too

county_fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS code, e.g. "48029" for Bexar County, TX

state.description: two-letter state code, needed with county

name: loan_limit
